protocol.asset_split: SHA256(base asset) mod 5 == 0 withheld from all training; quote aliases share the same split
protocol.execution: Signals use completed daily candles, next-next daily open fills, full funded accounting. Current catalog minimum notional and base increment applied with explicit current-vintage caveat.
protocol.forward_requirement: Separate future paper observations after frozen source/model selection; not inferred from reused historical periods
protocol.missing_data: No interpolation. Missing held-position marks valued at zero until an actual candle returns; no retroactive exits before gaps. Final missing quote gives zero liquidation value. Invalid lookback prevents new decisions.
protocol.observation: 35 existing market features plus exposure, holding age, unrealized price return, net wealth relative to initial capital
protocol.qualification: Historical reused data, current-survivor listing bias, no independent profitability or competitor superiority claim. New-to-model asset cohort is distinct from never-before-researched assets.
protocol.quotes: Only USD markets enter funded portfolio. All USDC markets collected and counted, but no unverified 1:1 conversion is assumed. Prefer USD for duplicate base assets.
protocol.selection: All neural arms and losses retained, no choosing a neural winner on evaluation returns. The single expert control is selected using training-only funded net return, and frozen before either evaluation.
protocol.training: Actual existing SpongeDQN. Matched gamma=0 and gamma=.99 arms; seed41; identical source order and one full mini-batch gradient per <=64-row cohort. Training labels only mature before training_end. Counterfactual branches from fixed expert trajectories, at most26 decisions per training episode. Full states retained.

scope.listing_scope: Current-vintage listings, not point-in-time or authenticated account permissions
